## Original article text

````markdown
## Description
Used in [Start Facing](/wiki/articles/start+facing), [Apply Impulse](/wiki/articles/apply+impulse), [Set Facing](/wiki/articles/set+facing), [Start Accelerating](/wiki/articles/start+accelerating) and [Start Throttle In Direction](/wiki/articles/start+throttle+in+direction). Specifies whether the direction is relative to world coordinates or the local coordinates of the player or players.

## Options
- **To Player** 
  - Relative to the player's local coordinate system (which moves and rotates with the player).
- **To World** 
  - Relative to the world's coordinate system.
````
